infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Meeboo uses your camera to log meals and recipe videos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Meeboo needs access to your photo library to upload recipe videos.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Meeboo reads sleep, steps and activity to track your progress automatically.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Meeboo writes your logged workouts and water intake to Apple Health.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Meeboo reads your calendar to plan workouts around your week.
